# Vendored third-party code

| File | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wywo-quicktype.js` | [Sukonik/wywo `src/quicktype.js`](https://github.com/Sukonik/wywo/blob/6e19b35/src/quicktype.js) at commit `6e19b35`, copied unmodified | Mozilla Public License 2.0 (`LICENSE-wywo-MPL-2.0.txt`) |

`wywo-quicktype.js` is the WYWO ("While You Were Out") quick-type parser: it sorts a plain-words phone message into a caller, company, phone, who it is for, urgency, and topics. MARSAI uses it for "take a message". The file is kept unmodified and under MPL-2.0; update it by copying the new version from the WYWO repository.
